verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no opt-out for telemetry or usage tracking in CodeRabbit's app, CLI, or IDE extensions. The nearest items cover related but different controls: a no-training-on-code policy, data-retention opt-out on self-hosted Enterprise, and a controllable model-output-logging setting. None of these covers telemetry or usage-tracking collection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
